# Synthetic audit fixture: temporary credentials under the security-token
# label spellings real tooling uses — the signed-request header
# X-Amz-Security-Token, the JSON SecurityToken key, and the SECURITY_TOKEN
# environment form. The label detector matches a lowercased copy of the line,
# so the security spelling is one more first-word variant of the same
# session-token detector (the x-amz- prefix sits before the matched span).
# Synthetic values.

"SecurityToken": "SYNTHETICSECURITYTOKENABCDEFGHIJ"
